description_en: A call to the GetCallerIdentity operation returns information about the identity of the current caller
description_zh: 调用GetCallerIdentity获取当前调用者的身份信息
name: GetCallerIdentity

AccountId.description_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account to which the current caller belongs
AccountId.description_zh: 当前调用者所属阿里云账号ID

Arn.description_en: The Alibaba Cloud Resource Name (ARN) of the current caller

IdentityType.description_en:
The type of the identity. Valid values:

Account: an Alibaba Cloud account.
RAMUser: a RAM user.
AssumedRoleUser: a RAM role
IdentityType.description_zh:
身份类型。取值：

Account：阿里云账号（主账号）。
RAMUser：RAM用户。
AssumedRoleUser：RAM角色

RoleId.description_en:
The ID of the RAM role.

This parameter is returned only when the caller is a RAM role
RoleId.description_zh:
RAM角色ID。

仅限当前调用者是RAM角色时返回该参数

UserId.description_en:
The user ID. Details are as follows:

If the caller is an Alibaba Cloud account, the ID of the Alibaba Cloud account is returned.
If the caller is a RAM user, the ID of the RAM user is returned.

This parameter is returned only when the caller is an Alibaba Cloud account or a RAM user
UserId.description_zh:
用户ID。具体如下：

如果当前调用者是阿里云账号，则返回阿里云账号ID。
如果当前调用者是RAM用户，则返回RAM用户ID。

仅限当前调用者是阿里云账号或RAM用户时返回该参数
